title: "Validation"
page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false

```{=html}
<div class="validation-hero">
  <div>
    <div class="validation-kicker">CLUSTER SEQUOIA</div>
    <h1>Validation des nouvelles publications</h1>
    <p>
      Confirmer la prédiction du modèle ou corriger directement le pilier
      et l’axe scientifique.
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="validation-stats">
    <div>
      <strong id="stat-pending">—</strong>
      <span>à vérifier</span>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong id="stat-validated">—</strong>
      <span>validées</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="validation-toolbar">
  <label>
    Validateur
    <input
      id="reviewer-input"
      type="text"
      placeholder="Nom ou initiales"
      autocomplete="off"
    />
  </label>

  <label>
    Ordre
    <select id="order-select">
      <option value="confidence_asc">Moins sûres d’abord</option>
      <option value="confidence_desc">Plus sûres d’abord</option>
      <option value="year_desc">Plus récentes d’abord</option>
    </select>
  </label>

  <label class="search-field">
    Recherche
    <input
      id="search-input"
      type="search"
      placeholder="Titre, auteur, HAL ID…"
    />
  </label>

  <button id="search-button" class="btn-secondary">
    Rechercher
  </button>
</div>

<div id="validation-message" class="validation-message"></div>

<div id="empty-state" class="empty-state" hidden>
  <h3>Aucune publication à valider</h3>
  <p>La file de validation est vide pour la sélection actuelle.</p>
</div>

<div id="validation-card" class="validation-card" hidden>

  <div class="article-meta-row">
    <span id="article-year" class="meta-badge"></span>
    <span id="article-hal-id" class="meta-badge muted"></span>
    <span id="queue-position" class="meta-badge muted"></span>
  </div>

  <h2 id="article-title"></h2>

  <div id="article-authors" class="article-authors"></div>

  <div class="article-links">
    <a id="article-hal-link" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      Voir sur HAL
    </a>
    <a id="article-doi-link" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" hidden>
      DOI
    </a>
  </div>

  <div class="abstract-box">
    <div class="abstract-label">Résumé</div>
    <p id="article-abstract"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="prediction-grid">
    <div class="prediction-card">
      <span class="prediction-label">Pilier proposé</span>
      <strong id="predicted-pillar"></strong>
      <span id="pillar-confidence" class="confidence"></span>
    </div>

    <div class="prediction-card">
      <span class="prediction-label">Axe proposé</span>
      <strong id="predicted-axis"></strong>
      <span id="axis-similarity" class="confidence"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="correction-panel">
    <h3>Validation humaine</h3>

    <div class="correction-grid">
      <label>
        Pilier
        <select id="pillar-select"></select>
      </label>

      <label>
        Axe
        <select id="axis-select"></select>
      </label>
    </div>

    <div class="action-row">
      <button id="previous-article" class="btn-secondary">
        ← Précédent
      </button>

      <button id="validate-as-is" class="btn-primary">
        ✓ Valider tel quel
      </button>

      <button id="validate-correction" class="btn-accent">
        Corriger et valider
      </button>

      <button id="skip-article" class="btn-secondary">
        Passer
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  // En local, FastAPI tourne sur le port 8000.
  // Lors du déploiement, il suffira de remplacer cette URL.
  const API_BASE =
    ((window.location.hostname === "localhost" ||
      window.location.hostname === "127.0.0.1") &&
    window.location.port !== "10000")
      ? "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
      : "";

  const state = {
    items: [],
    index: 0,
    total: 0,
    taxonomy: null,
    search: "",
    order: "confidence_asc"
  };

  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);

  const statPending = el("stat-pending");
  const statValidated = el("stat-validated");
  const reviewerInput = el("reviewer-input");
  const orderSelect = el("order-select");
  const searchInput = el("search-input");
  const searchButton = el("search-button");

  const messageBox = el("validation-message");
  const emptyState = el("empty-state");
  const card = el("validation-card");

  const yearEl = el("article-year");
  const halIdEl = el("article-hal-id");
  const positionEl = el("queue-position");
  const titleEl = el("article-title");
  const authorsEl = el("article-authors");
  const abstractEl = el("article-abstract");
  const halLink = el("article-hal-link");
  const doiLink = el("article-doi-link");

  const predictedPillarEl = el("predicted-pillar");
  const predictedAxisEl = el("predicted-axis");
  const pillarConfidenceEl = el("pillar-confidence");
  const axisSimilarityEl = el("axis-similarity");

  const pillarSelect = el("pillar-select");
  const axisSelect = el("axis-select");

  const previousButton = el("previous-article");
  const validateAsIsButton = el("validate-as-is");
  const validateCorrectionButton = el("validate-correction");
  const skipButton = el("skip-article");

  reviewerInput.value = localStorage.getItem("sequoia_reviewer") || "";

  reviewerInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    localStorage.setItem(
      "sequoia_reviewer",
      reviewerInput.value.trim()
    );
  });

  function showMessage(text, type = "info") {
    messageBox.textContent = text || "";
    messageBox.className = `validation-message ${type}`;
  }

  function formatPercent(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
      return "—";
    }

    return `${Math.round(Number(value) * 100)} %`;
  }

  function formatSimilarity(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
      return "—";
    }

    return Number(value).toFixed(3);
  }

  async function api(path, options = {}) {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        ...(options.headers || {})
      },
      ...options
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      let detail = `HTTP ${response.status}`;

      try {
        const body = await response.json();
        detail = body.detail || detail;
      } catch (_) {}

      throw new Error(detail);
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  async function loadStats() {
    const stats = await api("/api/validation/stats");

    statPending.textContent =
      Number(stats.to_review || 0).toLocaleString("fr-FR");

    statValidated.textContent =
      Number(stats.validated || 0).toLocaleString("fr-FR");
  }

  async function loadTaxonomy() {
    state.taxonomy = await api("/api/taxonomy");

    pillarSelect.innerHTML = "";

    for (const pillar of state.taxonomy.pillars) {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = pillar;
      option.textContent = pillar;
      pillarSelect.appendChild(option);
    }
  }

  function refreshAxisOptions(selectedAxis = "") {
    const pillar = pillarSelect.value;
    const axes =
      state.taxonomy?.axes_by_pillar?.[pillar] || [];

    axisSelect.innerHTML = "";

    if (pillar === "No class") {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = "";
      option.textContent = "Aucun axe";
      axisSelect.appendChild(option);
      axisSelect.disabled = true;
      return;
    }

    axisSelect.disabled = false;

    for (const axis of axes) {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = axis;
      option.textContent = axis;

      if (axis === selectedAxis) {
        option.selected = true;
      }

      axisSelect.appendChild(option);
    }

    if (
      selectedAxis &&
      !axes.includes(selectedAxis)
    ) {
      axisSelect.value = axes[0] || "";
    }
  }

  function currentArticle() {
    return state.items[state.index] || null;
  }

  function renderCurrent() {
    const article = currentArticle();

    if (!article) {
      card.hidden = true;
      emptyState.hidden = false;
      return;
    }

    emptyState.hidden = true;
    card.hidden = false;

    yearEl.textContent = article.year || "Année inconnue";
    halIdEl.textContent = article.halId_s || "";

    positionEl.textContent =
      `${state.index + 1} / ${state.items.length}` +
      (state.total > state.items.length
        ? ` — ${state.total.toLocaleString("fr-FR")} trouvées`
        : "");

    titleEl.textContent =
      article.title || "Sans titre";

    authorsEl.textContent =
      article.authors || "Auteurs non renseignés";

    abstractEl.textContent =
      article.abstract || "Résumé non disponible.";

    if (article.url) {
      halLink.href = article.url;
      halLink.hidden = false;
    } else {
      halLink.hidden = true;
    }

    if (article.doi) {
      const doi = String(article.doi)
        .replace(/^https?:\/\/(dx\.)?doi\.org\//i, "")
        .replace(/^doi:\s*/i, "");

      doiLink.href = `https://doi.org/${encodeURIComponent(doi)}`;
      doiLink.hidden = false;
    } else {
      doiLink.hidden = true;
    }

    predictedPillarEl.textContent =
      article.predicted_pillar || "—";

    predictedAxisEl.textContent =
      article.predicted_axis || "—";

    pillarConfidenceEl.textContent =
      `Confiance : ${formatPercent(article.pillar_confidence)}`;

    axisSimilarityEl.textContent =
      `Similarité : ${formatSimilarity(article.axis_similarity)}`;

    pillarSelect.value =
      article.predicted_pillar || "No class";

    refreshAxisOptions(
      article.predicted_axis || ""
    );

    showMessage("");
  }

  async function loadQueue() {
    showMessage("Chargement de la file de validation…");

    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      limit: "200",
      offset: "0",
      order: state.order
    });

    if (state.search) {
      params.set("search", state.search);
    }

    const result = await api(
      `/api/articles/to-review?${params.toString()}`
    );

    state.items = result.items || [];
    state.total = Number(result.total || 0);
    state.index = 0;

    renderCurrent();
    showMessage("");
  }

  async function submitValidation(pillar, axis) {
    const article = currentArticle();

    if (!article) {
      return;
    }

    const reviewer =
      reviewerInput.value.trim() || null;

    previousButton.disabled = true;
    validateAsIsButton.disabled = true;
    validateCorrectionButton.disabled = true;
    skipButton.disabled = true;

    try {
      await api(
        `/api/articles/${encodeURIComponent(article.halId_s)}/validate`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            validated_pillar: pillar,
            validated_axis: axis || null,
            reviewer
          })
        }
      );

      showMessage(
        `✓ ${article.halId_s} validé.`,
        "success"
      );

      state.items.splice(state.index, 1);
      state.total = Math.max(0, state.total - 1);

      if (state.index >= state.items.length) {
        state.index = Math.max(
          0,
          state.items.length - 1
        );
      }

      await loadStats();

      if (
        state.items.length === 0 &&
        state.total > 0
      ) {
        await loadQueue();
      } else {
        renderCurrent();
      }

    } catch (error) {
      showMessage(
        `Erreur : ${error.message}`,
        "error"
      );

    } finally {
      previousButton.disabled = false;
      validateAsIsButton.disabled = false;
      validateCorrectionButton.disabled = false;
      skipButton.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  validateAsIsButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    async () => {
      const article = currentArticle();

      if (!article) return;

      await submitValidation(
        article.predicted_pillar,
        article.predicted_axis
      );
    }
  );

  validateCorrectionButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    async () => {
      await submitValidation(
        pillarSelect.value,
        axisSelect.value
      );
    }
  );

  previousButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {
      if (state.items.length <= 1) {
        return;
      }

      state.index =
        (state.index - 1 + state.items.length) % state.items.length;

      renderCurrent();
    }
  );

  skipButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {
      if (state.items.length <= 1) {
        return;
      }

      state.index =
        (state.index + 1) % state.items.length;

      renderCurrent();
    }
  );

  pillarSelect.addEventListener(
    "change",
    () => {
      refreshAxisOptions("");
    }
  );

  orderSelect.addEventListener(
    "change",
    async () => {
      state.order = orderSelect.value;

      try {
        await loadQueue();
      } catch (error) {
        showMessage(
          `Erreur : ${error.message}`,
          "error"
        );
      }
    }
  );

  searchButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    async () => {
      state.search = searchInput.value.trim();

      try {
        await loadQueue();
      } catch (error) {
        showMessage(
          `Erreur : ${error.message}`,
          "error"
        );
      }
    }
  );

  searchInput.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    event => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        searchButton.click();
      }
    }
  );

  async function initialize() {
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        loadTaxonomy(),
        loadStats()
      ]);

      await loadQueue();

    } catch (error) {
      card.hidden = true;
      emptyState.hidden = true;

      showMessage(
        "Impossible de joindre l’API de validation. " +
        `Détail : ${error.message}`,
        "error"
      );
    }
  }

  initialize();
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<style>
.validation-hero {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2rem;

  margin: 1.8rem 0 1rem;
  padding: 2.3rem 2.7rem;

  border-radius: 22px;
  color: white;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 82% 20%,
      rgba(70, 120, 255, 0.72),
      transparent 34%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      120deg,
      #101b3c 0%,
      #172554 55%,
      #244ba8 100%
    );

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 35px rgba(16, 27, 60, 0.16);
}

.validation-kicker {
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;

  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14rem;

  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
}

.validation-hero h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.55rem;
  color: white !important;
  font-size: 2.3rem;
}

.validation-hero p {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
}

.validation-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1.2rem;
}

.validation-stats div {
  min-width: 115px;
  padding: 1rem 1.2rem;

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.validation-stats strong {
  display: block;
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.55rem;
}

.validation-stats span {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
}

.validation-toolbar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns:
    minmax(150px, 0.8fr)
    minmax(190px, 1fr)
    minmax(250px, 1.5fr)
    auto;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  align-items: end;

  margin: 1rem 0;
  padding: 1rem;

  border: 1px solid #e4e8f0;
  border-radius: 15px;
  background: white;
}

.validation-toolbar label,
.correction-grid label {

}

  color: #172033;
}

.validation-card {
  margin: 1rem 0 2rem;
  padding: 1.5rem;

  border: 1px solid #e4e8f0;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 20px rgba(20, 31, 60, 0.05);
}

  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

}

.meta-badge.muted {
  background: #f1f3f7;

}

.validation-card h2 {

}

.article-authors {
  color: #5e687d;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.article-links {
  display: flex;

}

}

}

.btn-primary {

  color: white;
}

.btn-secondary {

}

}

.validation-message {
  min-height: 1.4rem;

}

}

}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .validation-hero {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .validation-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

  .prediction-grid,

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .validation-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

    width: 100%;
  }

    flex: 1;
  }
}
</style>
```
